content_sections.heading: MSU Baroda Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Temporary Assistant Professor (Computer): Master’s degree with 55% marks (or equivalent) in relevant subject, NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018 Temporary Assistant Professor (Human Development and Family Studies): Master’s degree with 55% marks (or equivalent) in relevant subject, NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MSU Baroda recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Temporary Assistant Professor posts at MSU Baroda is scheduled for 22 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Temporary Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree with 55% marks in the concerned/relevant subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Temporary Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Temporary Assistant Professor posts, with one each for Computer and Human Development and Family Studies.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the MSU Baroda recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250 for SC/ST candidates. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the MSU Baroda office. Specific details regarding the exact venue and time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any age-related information or relaxations.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature, meaning the appointment is for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the offer letter.

faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article by clicking on the provided link for the Official Notification PDF.
